model: Category markers and detail icons draw at 32px to 42px. 42*3 = 126 device pixels, so 128px is enough. The previous category PNGs were 256px, which is (256/128)^2 = 4 times as many pixels. The detail panel and several map fallbacks request the PNG directly.

noise.rule: File sizes are deterministic. Already-128px files were left unchanged and are included in both totals.
